Game Overview

In Othello, the core idea is straightforward: othello is a strategic showdown of wit and cunning, where your objective is to outmaneuver your opponent by capturing and flipping their discs. Perfect your tactics, seize the corners, and adapt your plans as you battle it out in intense two-player duels across various board sizes.
